kind: developer-only task-local WSOLA-style rate adapter model; not a production playback actuator

rate_model.source_clock: integer source sample index; rate schedule keyed by source sample
rate_model.output_clock: caller-owned fractional accumulator; 1/r output frames per source frame
rate_model.algorithm: WSOLA-style bounded waveform-similarity search, triangular overlap-add and transient-aware placement
rate_model.rate_change: slew by 0.005 per synthesis hop; adverse unsmoothed step is a failure control
rate_model.pitch: preserved by time-domain overlap-add; varispeed resampling is an adverse control only
rate_model.silence: zero-valued analytic control with the same duration clock
rate_model.pause_filler: source-anchored voiced/pause schedule; no output-time filler invention
rate_model.final_window: partial input valid count plus explicit drain padding; missing tail rejected

c_boundary.off_mode: guard executable only; no provider source, descriptor header, AudioSDK link or registration
c_boundary.on_mode: caller-local registration and exact Python/C parity test in one consumer executable
c_boundary.parity: float32 content digest, frame count, valid counts, final partial window and drain status compared exactly with the Python model

non_claims: no GPL/LGPL or commercial SoundTouch dependency is added
no real speech, music, corpus, model, device, listening or timing result
no installed v0, descriptor default, provider registry or public-surface change
